preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The position k is between 1 and the minimum of 10^18 and the length of Kyoya's list l inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) in range(1, n+1) for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: The output contains distinct integers from 1 to n.
The output permutation is the k-th permutation in Kyoya's list, which does not change after converting to standard cyclic representation and removing parentheses.
